definitions.explanation: Describes technology or methods that work without physical contact, such as contactless payment systems, sensors, or thermometers. Composed of {非|ひ} (non-) + {接触|せっしょく} (contact).

examples.japanese: {非接触|ひせっしょく}⟦{決済|けっさい}→決済：05466_kessai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
{非接触|ひせっしょく}{型|がた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体温計|たいおんけい}→体温計：05484_taionkei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}った→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: I took my temperature with a non-contact thermometer.

examples.japanese: ⟦コロナ{禍|か}→コロナ禍：29315_koronaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{非接触|ひせっしょく}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}した→普及する：22182_fukyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: Triggered by the pandemic, contactless services spread rapidly.

notes:
USAGE:
{非接触|ひせっしょく} functions as a noun that modifies other nouns, often with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or as a prefix: {非接触|ひせっしょく}⟦{決済|けっさい}→決済：05466_kessai⟧ (contactless payment), {非接触|ひせっしょく}{型|がた} (non-contact type). It became widely used during the COVID-19 pandemic as contactless services expanded.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非接触|ひせっしょく}⟦{決済|けっさい}→決済：05466_kessai⟧ (contactless payment)
- {非接触|ひせっしょく}{型|がた} (non-contact type)
- {非接触|ひせっしょく}ICカード (contactless IC card)
- {非接触|ひせっしょく}⟦センサー→センサー：29781_sensaa⟧ (non-contact sensor)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{接触|せっしょく}→接触：12904_sesshoku⟧ means contact or touching.
- ⟦タッチ{決済|けっさい}→タッチ決済：09692_tacchikessai⟧ is another term for contactless payment using loanword.
- ⟦{非対面|ひたいめん}→非対面：15439_hitaimen⟧ means without face-to-face interaction.
